label: Universal esse giving through rational exercise: priority and one-power routes
summary: The priority route gives owned rational exercise at each distinct actual effect from firstness, a simply prior intellect for non-rational giving, classified exercise of an owned power, and the adapter from tenseless esse causation to giving at w. The one-power route reuses b5b84276 with one-power simplicity for qualifying universal causes and the same adapter. Omission controls retain a universal cause with intellect and will, including ownership of a rational power. Fixed non-rational exercise disputes the natural-priority premise in the structural profile. Fixed rational exercise separates exercise from modal freedom, effect direction, recipient-good willing and NarDerivation's fixity-to-required-means rule. Explicit applications compose rational exercise into 123d394b and a94c5dfc, used respectively by the LORD_2 route and the recipient-willing input of LORD_3. bb3d4417 still needs its causal-subjection-to-dominion rationale. The through-will checkpoint in docs/notes/divine-love-goodness-bridge.md records the scope, rival comparison and provisional warrant.
blocker: Rational exercise is an effect-indexed classification. The strongest unresolved question is what shows that apprehended content actually governs universal esse production for each effect. Test per-effect practical specification against the same fixed output with mere foresight or adoption of a whole order, and distinguish direction from willing good to that recipient. For the priority route, test the foundational non-rational disposition rival and whether causal asymmetry and simple priority give firstness on this scope.
